from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=["Decrypt the ciphertext using the hint pair. Propose one full uppercase plaintext candidate with the exact ciphertext length. Other proposals:\n{all_proposals}\nProblem:\n{problem}"] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt="Select the best decryption candidate for the problem. Prefer the candidate that best matches the hint-derived cipher rule and preserves the exact ciphertext length. Output only the single best uppercase plaintext candidate with no explanation.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nCandidates:\n{all_proposals}", n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        final_star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.FINAL_DECRYPT_CANDIDATE] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.FINAL_DECRYPT_AGGREGATE)
        final = await final_star(f"Problem:\n{problem}\nDraft plaintext candidate:\n{draft['response']}")
        return final['response'], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
